_what: The executable half of STATS_RULES.md §9's 开跑前置条件 rows. Read by freeze/launch_gate.py, which is the thing that answers 'may the sealed campaign spend?'. §9 is the authority for WHICH rows are blockers; this file records, per row, the command that clears one.
_how_a_blocker_clears: state=implemented, plus a cmd template containing {target}, plus two targets that both exist on disk. The gate runs the SAME template against positive_target (must exit 0) and negative_target (must exit non-zero). A check that only ever runs on things it should pass cannot be told apart from a stub, so the rejection is the half that carries the weight.
_how_it_does_not_clear: Editing this file. Every field here is an instruction to run something; none of them is believed.

9.14.subject: U3 attainment rate has no implementation at all
9.14.why: One of the three primary endpoints, with no prediction, no battery id, and no consumer for Step.won (build_manifest.py:173-178, PREDICTIONS.md:585, battery ENDPOINTS.md:15 'unfalsifiable'). Freezing a statistical ruling over a quantity nothing computes freezes an unexecutable sentence.
9.14.clears_when: the rate can be computed end to end at least once, and the computation rejects a run in which no game was won

9.15.subject: 「弃权计错」与它点名的实现方向相反
9.15.why: STATS_RULES.md §2.2 pre-registers 弃权计错 and names exam/grading/mark.py:95 confusion() as the implementation. That implementation does the opposite and says so: abstentions (:125-130), unanswered submissions (:120-124) and illegible answers (:131-144) each `continue` out of the tp/fp/tn/fn tally, so there are THREE exits from the specificity denominator, not one. exam/DECISIONS.md D-EX-015 records the opposite semantics as 'the right call'. The cheapest rescue reading of an unfavourable result therefore costs ZERO: abstain on the class-iii items you are unsure of and the cited implementation removes them from the denominator. Worse, _rate (:155-156) returns None on an empty denominator (confusion_matrix.py:23-26 makes this a design principle), and `None < ⟨S_min⟩` is not false but undefined -- so the one-vote specificity veto has no total order and can be made structurally untriggerable.
9.15.clears_when: A conversion layer (`abstain_as_wrong`) exists and is hashed, counting abstained/unanswered/unclassified into the error cell on the corresponding truth side, so that tp+fn and tn+fp equal the class sizes and neither rate is ever undefined; OR the exam track changes mark.confusion's semantics and D-EX-015 is superseded. Either way the row clears with a command and two targets, per this file's contract -- not by editing this entry.
9.15.negative_target_when_implemented: an examinee transcript that abstains on every class-iii item: the layer must score it as wrong, not as 1.000
9.15.note: Invisible to verify.sh stage [16] by construction: 弃权计错 IS stated in both frozen files, so the wording gate is green on it. This is a rule-vs-implementation defect, which is a different gate. Registered by RES-1, E-WORDING, 2026-07-29; argued in STATS_RULES.md §2.3.1.

9.16.subject: 判决题 BA 分不出 `memoriser` 与真值
9.16.why: The pre-registered scalar is BA = (sensitivity + specificity)/2 taken from the confusion half, with the exam's total score demoted to exploratory (§2.2, citing Theoria.md:259 '这里考的是理由'). The measurement contradicts that choice. exam/DECISIONS.md:371-374: the memoriser's pooled pair is sensitivity 1.000 / specificity 1.000, 'numerically identical to ground truth', while it abstains on 4 of 4 large-space items -- so BA = 1.000 for an arm that has never answered the class the campaign exists to test. exam/STATUS.md:53-56: `oracle` and `cheater-v4` are identical in EVERY cell of the class split and differ only in the score -- the very quantity §2.2 demotes. This is not a wording that can be gamed; it is a wording that, executed correctly, returns the wrong conclusion.
9.16.clears_when: Both mandatory negative controls run and are hashed before any sealed game: `bluffer` must be judged 不成立, and `memoriser` must NOT be judged 成立. Plus the class-split adjudication is in force with a ⟨c_min⟩ floor on class (ii) coverage_positive, whose breach routes to 不可结论 (not 不成立). ⟨c_min⟩ is itself needs_human.
9.16.negative_target_when_implemented: exam's `memoriser` examinee: the endpoint must refuse to judge it 成立
9.16.note: Supersedes and tightens 9.12, which pinned `bluffer` alone -- and `bluffer` is already killed by the specificity floor, so it was the control that did not need to be run. Registered by RES-1, E-WORDING, 2026-07-29; argued in STATS_RULES.md §2.3.2.
